title: The Rotted Hall interior, by the hearth. Same cell as interior_firelit; kept as a separate id because the interior is a named place and the anchor is a camera slot.
settlement_note: W1-GIVER-PRESENCE: this state named a cell and a region but never its town, so Engine.applyNamedState() had nothing to hand populateSettlement() and the state held only the people its `npcs:` block types out by hand. Naming the town is what makes the rest of it exist.
